TRAIN A LORA

1. Make a folder, inside it a folder named  4_mychar  with your images (20-100).
   Next to every image a .txt file with the same name and a sentence describing the image, always starting the same way:
   "Safe image. ohwx, an adult woman with long black hair, red eyes, white tank top. She stands in a park."
2. dataset_folder = your folder,  lora_name = any name.  Press Run.
3. Report says READY -> switch start on, press Run. A black window opens and trains (~1 h).
   (First time it installs the trainer first - then press Run once more.)
4. Press Run any time to see the progress. When it says done, open "Test my LoRA".
